   - The `getNextEntry()` method is called on the `in` object (which was created at line 5)
   - So the value of `entry` is directly dependent on the value of `in` (specifically, on the state of the ZipInputStream object that `in` represents)
4. At line 9, `action.process(in, entry)` - here `entry` is used as an argument

The value of `entry` is determined by calling `in.getNextEntry()` at line 7, which means the value of `entry` directly depends on the value/state of `in` that exists at line 5 (when `in` was created and initialized).
